text:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: Pager — elevated 5xx rate on api.redwood-inference.com (prod canary). Error-rate ~32% on /v1/generate since 04:05 UTC. Canary deploy 2143 in flight. Auto-alerting oncall.

sam (oncall): Oncall ack. looking at logs now. any idea which change in 2143?

amy (infra): 2143 included KMS key rotation + env var change for canary nodes (REDWOOD_KMS_KEY, REDWOOD_KMS_REGION). I pushed the rotation earlier but I didn’t sync canary envs — checking.

jamie (deploy): deploy-bot shows successful pod rollouts, but healthchecks are failing on canary. getting TLS/KMS errors in init containers.

leo (sre): throwing up quick query: `kubectl logs -l app=inference-canary -c init` -> lots of `access denied` from KMS client.

sam (oncall): paste logs?

leo (sre): ```
ERROR: failed to fetch key REDWOOD_KMS_KEY: AccessDeniedException: Caller does not have kms:Decrypt on arn:aws:kms:us-west-2:111122223333:key/abcd-rotated
    at com.redwood.kms.Client.decrypt(Client.java:82)
```

amy (infra): oh — we rotated the key but didn't attach new IAM role policy to the canary node role. prod workers had policy, canary role missing kms:Decrypt permission. my bad.

jamie (deploy): can we flip the feature flag to stop canary traffic? `ffctl set canary_kms_fallback false --env prod` ? Don’t want more customer requests hitting broken canary.

sam (oncall): agreed. jamie, flip it and then scale down canary pods.

jamie (deploy): done: `ffctl set canary_kms_fallback false --env prod` -> :white_check_mark: feature flag toggled. routing removed for 2% canary traffic.

deploy-bot: Rollout action: Re-routed 2% traffic away from canary -> done.

leo (sre): Confirming errors dropping on real prod: error-rate on /v1/generate fell from 32% -> 3% within two minutes. Canary traces still 500s.

sam (oncall): good. Now we need root cause + mitigation. Options: 1) attach kms:Decrypt to canary role and restart canary, or 2) full rollback of deploy 2143. Preference?

amy (infra): attaching policy is quick but we need to ensure rotated key is in the right alias and the role ARN is correct. I'll prepare an infra change; should be low-risk if done only to canary.

jamie (deploy): imo safer to rollback 2143 across prod if canary had config drift. But we already cut traffic off — we can fix canary and re-run canary validation. want to avoid customer-facing rollback.

sam (oncall): agree with jamie. No customer-facing impact now but some tenants did get 500s during window. product-ops, any objections to fixing canary in-place?

product-ops: No objection. prefer to avoid rollback. Need list of affected customers for comms.

amy (infra): I'll attach policy now and restart canary init pods. Command:
```
aws iam attach-role-policy --role-name canary-node-role --policy-arn arn:aws:iam::aws:policy/RedwoodKMSCanaryAccess
kubectl delete pods -l app=inference-canary -n prod
```
Applying...

amy (infra): :white_check_mark: policy attached. restarting canary pods.

leo (sre): watching logs. init containers now show `key fetched` and process started. healthchecks passing on new replicas.

deploy-bot: Canary pods restarted (4 -> 4 ready).

sam (oncall): nice. jamie, can you re-enable canary routing to 2% and run smoke tests?

jamie (deploy): re-enabled: `ffctl set canary_kms_fallback true --env prod` -> :white_check_mark: routing back to canary. smoke tests: 
```
curl -X POST https://api.redwood-inference.com/v1/generate -d '{"prompt":"test"}' -H 'Authorization: Bearer test'
```
responses are 200 and latency normal.

leo (sre): metrics: errors back to baseline 0.4% across prod, canary stable. Good.

sam (oncall): Incident summary: deploy 2143 included rotated KMS key and env var changes. Canary node role lacked kms:Decrypt for new key -> 500s for canary traffic. Automated paging fired when error-rate crossed threshold. Mitigation: feature flag removed from canary traffic, infra IAM policy attached to canary role, pods restarted, canary re-enabled.

product-ops: Customer impact: brief spike from 04:05–04:08 UTC. Affected: three tenants on dedicated/private with recent KMS rotations (IDs: tenant-101, tenant-217, tenant-998). Estimated requests failed ~120 each. No persisted data loss.

jamie (deploy): I'll kick off a rollback-playbook review to add a automatic pre-check that ensures new KMS key permissions are propagated to all target roles before rollout.

amy (infra): followups: 1) add IAM propagation check in deploy pipeline, 2) add canary env sync job, 3) run audit to ensure other roles have kms:Decrypt for rotated keys. I'll file infra tickets.

sam (oncall): tagging postmortem. Assign owners: infra->amy, deploy->jamie, comms->product-ops. I'll hand off to day oncall at 12:00 UTC for long-running tasks.

product-ops: writing customer note draft. will share in #customer-comms for approval.

deploy-bot: Deploy 2143: status set to ROLLBACK_NOT_REQUIRED (canary fixed).

sam (oncall): thanks team. closing pager. Will follow up with timeline and RCA in incidents channel. :v:
